about.aboutapp: NativeWeather is a cross-platform application for displaying current weather, short-term forecasts, and long-term forecasts. The application also shows current air pollution values and allows users to monitor important air quality indicators. It also includes global map data and meteorological map layers for the entire world.
about.openmeteo: Specialized data for air quality index (AQI) and pollution
about.openfreemap: Provides OpenFreeMap vector basemap tiles for interactive geographic maps
about.openweather: Alternative source for current weather and forecasts
about.title: About
about.weatherapi: The main source of data for current weather, forecasts, astronomical data, and weather map overlays
